plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, says the story of governments secretly recovering crashed unknown craft goes back a long way. He points to a scientist named Robert Sarbacher in 1950, and even earlier to Italy in 1933 under its dictator Benito Mussolini. If true, it would mean such recoveries began well before the famous American cases.
